# Style rules for this workspace's Markdown

Style authority lives in the `extended-mind-writing` skill
(`.github/skills/extended-mind-writing/`): `voice.md` is the voice reference,
`style-audit.md` the ban list, `SKILL.md` the procedure. For any writing or
revision of prose - articles under `content/`, drafts under `.drafts/`, or any
other markdown here - follow `SKILL.md` before editing.
